diagnosticObservations.precondition: CDP initially exposed only the Benchmark target.
diagnosticObservations.observedBehavior: Starting a non-call_user UI-TARS Local Browser run created a new Google target. The model reported seeing Google rather than the Benchmark page.
sourceEvidence: /Applications/UI TARS.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar: DefaultBrowserOperator.getInstance calls createPage, which navigates the new page to a search-engine URL: Google, Bing, or Baidu.
/Applications/UI TARS.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar: BaseBrowser.setupPageListener updates activePage through targetcreated and targetchanged.

/Applications/UI TARS.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar: BrowserOperator action space includes navigate(content='xxx'), but when the natural-language task asked the model to use navigation, the model still chose to click the address bar.
diagnosticObservations.conclusion: This was not a slow remote-model issue; it was caused by the Local Browser start page and activePage binding mechanism.
